## Objectives
* Illustrate the span / cluster ratio used in `subtree_cluster_matrix` (`geno_tc_cluster_summary.csv`, `geno_tc_cluster_spread.csv`) with a simulated toy tree for a single segment (HA)
* span = max cluster ID - min cluster ID + 1 (numeric IDs only, singletons excluded); ratio = span / n_clusters
* One tree, three queried genotypes drawn together (triangles coloured by genotype, summary table top left):
  1. Genotype X falls in a single cluster (span 1, ratio 1)
  2. Genotype Y falls in 3 contiguous clusters (span 3, ratio 1)
  3. Genotype Z falls in 3 non-contiguous clusters spread over a wider span (span 7, ratio 2.3)
* No real data: the tree is simulated as a caterpillar backbone (one tip per cluster, random branch lengths) with a tight random subtree (2-4 tips) grafted on each backbone tip, so every cluster is a monophyletic group of the closest sequences
* The tree is ladderized before plotting and clusters are numbered bottom -> top, matching the `02_rename_clusters` convention

# Setup
## libs
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gtools)
library(ape)
library(ggtree)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r}
plot.theme <- theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                    panel.background = element_rect("grey95"),
                    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
                    text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
                    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
                    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))

# tree panels: toy tree, so no axes, grid, border or legend; plain white background
tree.theme <- theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
                    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
                    axis.title = element_blank(),
                    axis.line = element_blank(),
                    panel.grid = element_blank(),
                    panel.border = element_blank(),
                    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
                    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
                    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, face = "plain"),
                    legend.position = "none")
```

## ins/outs
```{r}
seg <- "HA"
seed <- 2026
n.clust <- 7                      # clusters on the tree (every cluster belongs to one genotype)
size.range <- 2:4                 # tips per cluster
backbone.br <- c(0.3, 1)          # runif range for backbone (between-cluster) branches
cluster.br <- c(0.02, 0.08)       # runif range for within-cluster branches

# members = cluster numbers holding the queried genotype (no overlap between genotypes);
# geno = genotype name; col = triangle fill / legend / table colour
scenarios <- list(
  "01_single_cluster"        = list(members = 2, geno = "X", col = "#E41A1C"),
  "02_contiguous_ratio1"     = list(members = 4:6, geno = "Y", col = "#984EA3"),
  "03_noncontiguous"         = list(members = c(1, 3, 7), geno = "Z", col = "#FF7F00")
)

today <- Sys.Date()
f.out <- paste0(today, "_summary/")
if (!dir.exists(f.out)) {dir.create(f.out)}
```

# Functions
## simulate tree
```{r}
# caterpillar backbone with one tip per cluster; each backbone tip replaced by a short-branched
# random subtree, so each cluster is a monophyletic group of closest sequences.
# Ladderized with ape, then clusters numbered bottom -> top.
sim_cluster_tree <- function(n.clust, seg) {
  tree <- stree(n.clust, type = "left", tip.label = paste0("grp", seq_len(n.clust)))
  tree$edge.length <- runif(nrow(tree$edge), backbone.br[1], backbone.br[2])
  for (i in seq_len(n.clust)) {
    k <- sample(size.range, 1)
    sub <- rtree(k, tip.label = paste0("grp", i, "_", seq_len(k)),
                 br = runif, min = cluster.br[1], max = cluster.br[2])
    tree <- bind.tree(tree, sub, where = which(tree$tip.label == paste0("grp", i)))
  }
  tree <- ladderize(tree, right = FALSE)

  # tip y positions as drawn (ggtree with ladderize = FALSE keeps the ape ladderized order; y = 1 at the bottom)
  tips <- ggtree(tree, ladderize = FALSE)$data %>%
    filter(isTip) %>%
    select(label, y) %>%
    mutate(grp = sub("_\\d+$", "", label))

  grp.num <- tips %>%
    group_by(grp) %>%
    summarise(y.mean = mean(y), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(y.mean) %>%
    mutate(cluster_num = row_number())

  tips <- tips %>%
    left_join(grp.num %>% select(grp, cluster_num), by = "grp") %>%
    arrange(y) %>%
    mutate(new.label = sprintf("seq%02d", row_number()),
           cluster = paste0(seg, "_", cluster_num))

  tree$tip.label <- tips$new.label[match(tree$tip.label, tips$label)]
  tips <- tips %>% transmute(label = new.label, cluster, cluster_num)
  list(tree = tree, tips = tips)
}
```

## span / ratio
```{r}
# same definition as subtree_cluster_matrix: span = max - min + 1, ratio = span / n_clusters
span_ratio <- function(members) {
  n <- length(unique(members))
  span <- max(members) - min(members) + 1
  tibble(n_clusters = n, span = span, ratio = round(span / n, 1))
}
```


## plot tree
```{r}
# one tree, all genotypes: triangles filled by genotype, cluster labels right after each
# cluster's furthest tip; summary table (genotype legend as first column) above the tree,
# cluster legend top left of the tree panel
plot_cluster_tree <- function(tree, tips, n.clust, scenarios, ratio.tab, seg) {
  tips <- tips %>% mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = paste0(seg, "_", seq_len(n.clust))))
  p <- ggtree(tree, ladderize = FALSE) %<+% tips
  d <- p$data %>% filter(isTip)
  x.max <- max(d$x)
  tri.pad <- x.max * 0.03  # triangle base sits just right of the cluster's furthest tip
  lab.pad <- x.max * 0.05  # cluster label sits just right of the triangle base

  # one label per cluster, vertically centred on its tips, immediately right of its furthest tip
  lab <- d %>%
    group_by(cluster, cluster_num) %>%
    summarise(x = max(x) + lab.pad, y = mean(y), .groups = "drop")

  # one triangle per queried cluster: apex at the cluster MRCA, base spanning its tips
  tri <- imap_dfr(scenarios, function(sc, nm) {
    map_dfr(sc$members, function(m) {
      tip.lab <- d$label[d$cluster_num == m]
      mrca <- p$data %>% filter(node == getMRCA(tree, tip.lab))
      yr <- range(d$y[d$cluster_num == m]) + c(-0.4, 0.4)
      tri.x <- max(d$x[d$cluster_num == m]) + tri.pad
      tibble(genotype = sc$geno, cluster_num = m,
             x = c(mrca$x, tri.x, tri.x), y = c(mrca$y, yr[1], yr[2]))
    })
  })

  geno.cols <- set_names(map_chr(scenarios, "col"), map_chr(scenarios, "geno"))
  text.size <- 16          # legend text, table text and all headers/titles
  tri.alpha <- 0.6

  p <- p +
    geom_polygon(data = tri, inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = tri.alpha,
                 aes(x = x, y = y, group = interaction(genotype, cluster_num), fill = genotype)) +
    geom_tippoint(aes(color = cluster), size = 3) +
    geom_text(data = lab, inherit.aes = FALSE,
              aes(x = x, y = y, label = cluster),
              hjust = 0, size = 6) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = paste(seg, "cluster"), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = geno.cols, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, x.max * 1.15)) +
    expand_limits(y = c(0.5, nrow(d) + 0.5)) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_bw() + plot.theme + tree.theme +
    # cluster legend: highest cluster on top (matches the tree), top left of the panel, under the table
    guides(color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE, override.aes = list(size = 4))) +
    theme(legend.position = "inside",
          legend.position.inside = c(0, 1),
          legend.justification = c(0, 1),
          legend.title = element_text(size = text.size, face = "bold"),
          legend.text = element_text(size = text.size, face = "plain"),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.7, "cm"),
          legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
          legend.background = element_blank())

  # summary table; its first column is the genotype legend (fill key + name, centred)
  tab <- ratio.tab %>%
    transmute(Clusters = gsub(";", ", ", member_clusters),
              Span = span, `N clusters` = n_clusters, Ratio = sprintf("%.1f", ratio))
  tab.grob <- gridExtra::tableGrob(
    tab, rows = NULL,
    theme = gridExtra::ttheme_minimal(
      base_size = text.size,
      colhead = list(fg_params = list(fontface = "bold"))))

  key.cell <- function(geno) {
    grid::grobTree(
      grid::rectGrob(x = unit(0.5, "npc") - unit(0.15, "cm"), width = unit(0.6, "cm"),
                     height = unit(0.6, "cm"), just = "right",
                     gp = grid::gpar(fill = scales::alpha(geno.cols[[geno]], tri.alpha), col = NA)),
      grid::textGrob(geno, x = unit(0.5, "npc"), just = "left",
                     gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = text.size)))
  }
  tab.grob <- gtable::gtable_add_cols(tab.grob, unit(3.2, "cm"), pos = 0)
  tab.grob <- gtable::gtable_add_grob(
    tab.grob, grid::textGrob("Genotype", gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = text.size, fontface = "bold")),
    t = 1, l = 1, name = "geno-head")
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(ratio.tab))) {
    tab.grob <- gtable::gtable_add_grob(tab.grob, key.cell(ratio.tab$genotype[k]),
                                        t = k + 1, l = 1, name = paste0("geno-key-", k))
  }
  # left-justify the table so it starts at x = 0 like the cluster legend below it
  tab.grob$vp <- grid::viewport(x = unit(0, "npc"), just = "left",
                                width = sum(tab.grob$widths), height = sum(tab.grob$heights))

  # table stacked above the tree so it never overlaps branches
  wrap_plots(wrap_elements(full = tab.grob), p, ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 4.5))
}
```

# Simulate
```{r}
set.seed(seed)
sim <- sim_cluster_tree(n.clust, seg)

# genotype per cluster (NA = cluster not in any queried genotype)
clust.geno <- imap_dfr(scenarios, ~ tibble(cluster_num = .x$members, genotype = .x$geno))
tip.tab <- sim$tips %>%
  left_join(clust.geno, by = "cluster_num")

ratio.tab <- imap_dfr(scenarios, ~ span_ratio(.x$members) %>%
                        mutate(scenario = .y, genotype = .x$geno,
                               n_clusters_tree = n.clust,
                               n_tips_tree = nrow(sim$tips),
                               member_clusters = paste(paste0(seg, "_", .x$members), collapse = ";"),
                               min_id = min(.x$members),
                               max_id = max(.x$members)) %>%
                        relocate(scenario, genotype, n_clusters_tree, n_tips_tree, member_clusters, min_id, max_id))
ratio.tab
```

# Plot
```{r}
p.tree <- plot_cluster_tree(sim$tree, sim$tips, n.clust, scenarios, ratio.tab, seg)
p.tree
ggsave(paste0(f.out, "span_ratio_tree.png"), p.tree,
       width = 9, height = max(7, 2.5 + nrow(sim$tips) * 0.25), dpi = 300)
```

# Write
```{r}
write.csv(ratio.tab, paste0(f.out, "span_ratio_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(tip.tab, paste0(f.out, "span_ratio_tip_clusters.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.tree(sim$tree, paste0(f.out, "sim_tree.nwk"))
```
